_meta.purpose: Registry of retired dua URLs, for ADDENDUM §15(C). A slug listed here is excluded from the sitemap, never appears in Related Duas, and is never regenerated.
_meta.hostingConstraint: islamicinfo.org is served by GitHub Pages, which cannot issue server-side redirects. A 301 recorded here is therefore a DOCUMENTED INTENT, not a served response — the retired URL will 404 until the site gains a redirect-capable edge layer. Weigh that before retiring any URL that has been live long enough to be indexed.

rules.slugsStayFrozen: A retired slug is never deleted from slugs.lock.json. It stays reserved forever so the URL can never be reused for a different dua.
rules.approvalRequired: Retiring a URL requires explicit owner approval before commit (MASTER SPEC §1(D)).
